name: Anuradha
headline: Turn Radisson’s booking data into stays that come back.
saw: Your homepage sells stays, the rewards programme and Member Only Rate to every visitor in the same way, whether they come for Park, Stay and Fly or a Winter Stay Package.

Once a guest has stayed, booking history, the bonus points they earn but never spend, and the destinations they return to are your strongest signals for the next stay. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the guest receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns, including Deals of the Day and prepaid rates, are built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest about to switch brands this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or nothing.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per guest, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Reach the guest before they switch brands
cases.text: Per-guest churn signals from booking gaps, points activity and rate searches. The right offer, channel and moment, chosen for each guest and tested continuously across email and your website.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the next stay that fits
cases.text: Next best offer per guest, from stay history, rewards points and family or business travel. No more blanket mails to guests already on the right rate.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Give guests a reason to book again
cases.text: Personal nudges to packages such as Romance Experience or Family Experience, across email, web and rewards, so every guest has a reason to plan the next stay.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
